sources: Esri World Imagery around the 94 UseDirect site points

values.note: Same rates on the 2026 and 2027 sheets. On-season (Apr 15-Oct 31): basic/walk-in $15, electric 30A $27, sewer/electric/water 50A $35, family basic $22, family electric $42, platform tent $21. Off-season (Nov 1-Apr 14): basic $14, electric 30A $23, sewer/electric/water 50A $29. The electric/water 50A rate ($32/$26) is for the equestrian campground.

fees.source: Cuivre River 2026 and 2027 camping-rate sheets (mostateparks.com PDFs CampingFees_CuivreRiver_26.pdf and cuivre-camping-fees-2027.pdf), read 2026-11-08

hookups.source: UseDirect grid, facility 850 'Campground (sites 69-100)': 31 'Sewer/Electric/Water 50 amp' units; rate sheet '*Sewer/Electric/Water 50 AMP $35', read 2026-11-08

values.note: Showerhouse and running water Apr 15-Oct 31; off-season, water only from the frost-free spigot at site 69.

facilities.source: https://mostateparks.com/park/cuivre-river/camping (Campground 1 amenity symbols: running water, frost-free water, restroom, shower, dump station; 'During the off-season, potable water is available from the frost-free spigot at Campsite 69'), read 2026-11-08

note: Wooded campground in two loops: sites 1-68 (basic and 30A electric, with family double sites, walk-in and platform tent sites) and sites 69-100 (sewer/electric/water 50A). Lake Lincoln and its beach are a short walk away; the separate equestrian campground is for campers with horses. --Claude
summary: Rate sheets 2026/2027 confirm fees (basic $15/$14); entry's reservation_fee cleared (the state:MO row carries it). Hookups 50/w/s confirmed on the grid; facilities added. Pin 85 m from the site-point centre, fine. Lake Lincoln is ~100+ m through forest from the nearest pads: stays not waterfront. Note's site breakdown (50 basic/20 electric/30 full) was wrong and is rewritten.
flags: Site breakdown per UseDirect: sites 1-68 hold 37 basic, 18 electric 30A, 1 family electric, 2 family basic, 2 walk-in, 3 platform tent; sites 69-100 hold 31 sewer/electric/water 50A (94 bookable units in all; numbering runs to 100). sites.count 100 left as is.
